written.title: Explore the Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Gallery - Rockstar Games
written.description: What IGN, GamesRadar+ and Rockstar Newswire reported about Vice City on 3 November 2026, quoted in their own words with a link to each report.
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Vice City, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## IGN, 3 November 2026

['Save That Stuff for the Streets of Vice City' — Police Mock Car Chase Criminal for Getting Arrested Right Before GTA 6 Release](https://www.ign.com/articles/police-mock-car-chase-criminal-for-being-arrested-during-gta-6-release)

The outlet's own summary:

> Police in Derbyshire, UK, are going viral after making a TikTok video mocking a criminal who led them on a high-speed car chase, saying the suspect will now miss out on GTA 6’s highly-anticipated launch as a consequence of their actions.

> In Pictures: How GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Have Evolved Since 2023 View 13 Images According to the post’s caption, the incident took place in the town of Ripley.

> It’s shaping up to be one of the biggest pop culture events in history, with Rockstar going all-out on marketing; they partnered with Miami, Florida for a Vice City-themed takeover and collaborated with the Miami Heat to give them special, GTA 6-themed jerseys .

## GamesRadar+, 4 November 2026

[GTA 6's weather will rock your boat, damage your plane, and send Vice City denizens seeking shelter](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6s-weather-will-rock-your-boat-damage-your-plane-and-send-vice-city-denizens-seeking-shelter/)

The outlet's own summary:

> "This game is much more granular"

> Every Friday GamesRadar+ Your weekly update on everything you could ever want to know about the games you already love, games we know you're going to love in the near future, and tales from the communities that surround them.

> Citizens of Leonida will also seek shelter when severe weather passes through, which definitely feels distinctly Florida.

> Games Action Games Grand Theft Auto GTA 6 GTA 6's weather will rock your boat, damage your plane, and send Vice City denizens seeking shelter News By Jordan Gerblick Published 4 November 2026 "This game is much more granular" When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission.

## Rockstar Newswire, 5 November 2026

[Explore the Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Gallery - Rockstar Games](https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/39ak81277255o9/explore-the-grand-theft-auto-vi-launch-gallery)

The outlet's own summary:

> Grand Theft Auto VI is now officially only two weeks away. Today, enjoy a stunning look at Vice City and beyond with a collection of new screenshots on the official site.

> Please note that if you turn off some types of Cookies, it may limit your experience on the Site and the services we are able to offer.

> Today, enjoy a stunning look at Vice City and beyond with a collection of new screenshots on the official site.

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
